name: minitype-plugin-rubinate
description: Automatic Japanese ruby for minitype using Lindera IPADIC/UniDic WASM and furigana dictionaries

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node --test tests/*.test.mjs tmp/tests/*.test.js
scripts.example: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && node examples/.generated/basic.js
scripts.documentation: npm run build && npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.docs.json && node docs/.generated/build/index.js
scripts.documentation:images: npm run build && npm run check && tsc -p tsconfig.docs.json && node docs/.generated/build/readme-images.js
scripts.example:tsx: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && node examples/.generated/tsx.js
